reason: With 1,350 members and 27 holes, switching tee times, invoicing and the bar tab is a huge project, and you have no club live yet and only two founders. I can't bet my season and my evenings on a pilot that hasn't run anywhere.
objection: Our members are mostly over 60. Getting 1,350 people to install an app and log in with e-mail codes means weeks of phone calls and complaints at the front desk, and if the two of you get sick or stop, I'm left with a migration I can't undo.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle running on it for a full season, with their manager telling me how many older members actually use it and how many support calls it cost them.
